passages.context: The complete English letter, including the two fears it answers, the statement that the 1962 Missal was never juridically abrogated, the account of arbitrary deformations of the liturgy, the mutual-enrichment passage, and the sentence that what earlier generations held as sacred remains sacred and great for us too.

work.author: Pope Benedict XVI
work.description: Benedict XVI's letter of 7 July 2007 accompanying Summorum Pontificum, answering the fears that the motu proprio detracts from the authority of the Second Vatican Council or disturbs parishes, recounting the history of attachment to the 1962 Missal, and stating that the two forms can be mutually enriching and that what earlier generations held as sacred remains sacred and great.
work.title: Letter to the Bishops on the Occasion of the Publication of Summorum Pontificum
